description: A sensible consolidation that quietly creates a privacy and compliance problem.

flaws.description: Retaining full event payloads indefinitely conflicts with data-minimization and storage-limitation duties under GDPR-style regimes, regardless of storage cost.
No mechanism for honouring deletion or erasure requests once data is fanned into a warehouse and exported nightly to a third-party tool.
A nightly export of full customer data to a marketing tool is a new processor and a new exfiltration surface, with no DPA, scoping or field-level restriction mentioned.
Three whole teams get direct read access to full payloads, with no role-based restriction or audit logging.
Decommissioning all three source stores after a two-week dual-write leaves no way back if the unified store proves wrong.
